data.answer: Sobha Hartland 2 will be an expansive urban community spanning approximately 8 million sq. ft. that includes over 1 million sq. ft. of verdant greenery, providing residents with ample open spaces, tree-lined walkways, and parks.

The masterplan for Sobha Hartland 2 masterplan includes Sobha Estates, a gated villa community consisting of three clusters. As for the apartment towers, 350 Riverside Crescent and 320 Riverside Crescent are popular options, slated for completion in Q1 2027.

330 Riverside Crescent, a 57-story tower in Sobha Hartland II, is slated for handover in the second quarter of 2027, while 340 Riverside Crescent is projected to be completed in the fourth quarter of the same year. Additionally, 310 Riverside Crescent, another Sobha Hartland 2 Dubai building, is anticipated to be finished by April 2028.

These properties boast diverse amenities, including interactive play and sound sculptures, a yoga deck, and water features. Furthermore, residents can enjoy play areas, a pump track, and a trampoline. the reputation of Sobha Realty for delivering quality construction and design adds credibility to the project, which can be appealing to investors seeking long-term value.

Developments in Sobha Hartland 2

You can find villas and apartments in the community of Sobha Hartland: They include:

Sobha Estates, a gated villa community, will present Sobha Hartland with 2 villas with 5 and 6-bedroom residences. These Sobha Hartland 2 villas have three floors and feature a generous entrance courtyard and rooftop terrace.

310 Riverside Crescent is the fifth tower of the River Crescent Project. There are 1, 1.5, and 2-bedroom apartments in the tower along with an observation deck in the buildings offering breathtaking views of the surrounding.

Another tower in the River Crescent project in, 320 River Crescent features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments. There are open podiums and balconies where residents can enjoy breathtaking vistas.

330 Riverside Crescent is a 57-story tower offering 1 to 2-bedroom apartments. Residents can soak in beautiful views of the green area from the four-tiered terrace gardens. These spaces are connected with the restaurant and retail areas located on the ground floor.

Meanwhile, 340 Riverside Crescent will offer 1, 1.5, 2, and 2.5-bedroom apartments. You can find, a gym, infinity pool, sky garden and many other facilities in the tower.

In the residential building 350 Riverside Crescent, 1 to 2-bedroom apartments will be available. Residents of the building can enjoy stunning views of Downtown Dubai.

In 360 Riverside Crescent, there are 1 to 2-bedroom apartments spread across 70 floors. The skyscraper is the sixth residential building by Sobha Realty and is identical to 310 Riverside Crescent.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Sobha Hartland 2 Dubai
